annotations.title: Write a promoted-only X post for ads

description: Write an X post FOR ADS — PROMOTED-ONLY by default (X's 'nullcast'): it never appears on the brand's timeline or in followers' feeds and serves only as an ad, so you can test several creatives without spamming followers. Carry a card (cardUri from create_x_ads_card) OR up to 4 media (mediaKeys from upload_x_ads_media). Posted as the ad account's own promotable user (asUserId to choose). Pass lineItemId to attach it straight to a line item (which stays PAUSED). promotedOnly:false makes it a normal public post and needs confirmPublic:true. Read back from X. Free.

adAccountId.description: X ad account id (list_x_ads_accounts); omit if only one is shared

asUserId.description: promotable user id to post as; omit for the ad account's own user

cardUri.description: card_uri from create_x_ads_card; use instead of mediaKeys

confirmPublic.description: true is required with promotedOnly:false, to publish a public post

conversationSettings.description: who may reply to the post: EVERYONE, FOLLOWING or MENTIONED_USERS

lineItemId.description: attach to this line item right away

mediaKeys.description: up to 4 media keys from upload_x_ads_media

utm.description: UTM tags object: source, medium, campaign, content, term; appended to the destination URL

campaign.description: utm_campaign tag appended to websiteUrl; a tag already in the URL is kept

content.description: utm_content tag appended to websiteUrl; a tag already in the URL is kept

medium.description: utm_medium tag appended to websiteUrl; a tag already in the URL is kept

source.description: utm_source tag appended to websiteUrl; a tag already in the URL is kept

term.description: utm_term tag appended to websiteUrl; a tag already in the URL is kept

videoCta.description: call-to-action button on a video post: VISIT_SITE or WATCH_NOW

videoCtaUrl.description: URL the video call-to-action links to
